🌎 BEYOND THE 956

MIRAMAR, Fla. — A 32-year-old man was arrested Monday after police say he grabbed a 13-year-old girl outside a gas station and tried to walk off with her.

Miramar police say the incident happened around 5:34 p.m. on Monday, October 19, at the Shell station at 2840 South State Road 7. Surveillance video shows the man approaching the girl as she walked home, putting his arm around her shoulders and marching her away from the store.

According to police, the man also made what investigators described as provocative sexual and explicit comments toward the girl — including, per dispatch audio, telling her to "give him some kisses." A bystander intervened, yelling at the man and helping the girl break free. She ran into the gas station for help.

Officers located the suspect nearby after responding to reports of a separate disturbance. Police identified him as Michael Polanco, 32, of Davie, and say both the girl and a witness positively identified him. He was taken to the Broward County Main Jail.

Polanco faces charges of kidnapping involving bodily harm or terrorizing a victim and battery causing bodily harm. A judge denied him bond on Tuesday, and he remains in custody.

Police Chief Delrish Moss called Polanco's criminal history "extensive," noting prior convictions including indecent exposure. The girl's identity has not been publicly released because she is a minor.

The charges are allegations, and Polanco is presumed innocent unless and until he is convicted in court.

Sources: Miramar Police Department, as reported by NBC 6 South Florida, PEOPLE, and the New York Post, Oct. 19–22, 2026; WorldStar (@worldstar) on Instagram, Oct. 22, 2026.

title: Beyond the 956: Man arrested in Florida after allegedly trying to kidnap a 13-year-old girl at a gas station
